findings.title: Native Billing client search/paging invokes work selection and loses selector form
findings.configuration: test/fullcreate_app, native noJS behavior; selector_page_size1/search_limit4; own loopback diagnostic_test
findings.expected: HTTP200 Billing selector page with preserved dates, searched/paged client options; no business navigation
findings.observed: Rendered action/billing/work receives native lookup submit. Clearclient400 Invalidrequest; selectedclient200 workpage. Both lose lookup/periodediting controls. Normal validbusinesssubmit200workpage is positive control.
findings.impact: NoJS user cannot search/page Billing client selector; clearing the sole selected record under page size1 cannot recover a different client and entered dates disappear with errorpage
findings.alternatives_refuted: PH3 workselection is accepted business behavior, but shared selector fallback remains explicitly required; actual Searchbutton is submitted, not Choosework action. Validclient control independently shows the wrong branch even without validationfailure.
findings.correction: Route native selector actions back through Billing form rendering with retained form state; only explicit Choosework reaches/billing/work. Verify Search/Previous/Next with empty/selectedclient, native/JS and size1/multipage.
findings.audit_instrumentation_note: Initial probe assumed422; actual application errorhandler returns400. Initial failedoracle/log preserved; corrected probe reproduces same observed defect exit0. Original product untouched.

a11y_qualification: None of the original17 plus recovered6 browser failures is an axe violation. Initially65 setup errors did not exercise accessibility. Successful cases/replays remain separately counted; no global WCAG certification.
usage_B03_refutation: Confirmed conditional source defect: accepted disabled-by-default public collector is excluded from anonymous middleware routes; activation deferral does not waive source readiness. No actual Stage activation claimed.
qualification: Raw unsuccessful runs stay unsuccessful. Do not sum repeated nodes as new tests or present aggregate reruns as one full green invocation. Further parent recovery runs may supersede only individual node decisions.
